provenance: Read-only public Discord API via curl during Discord QA, 2026-11-08. Reduced to server identity and aggregate counts; no member identities.
notes: Widget presence_count differs from invite approximate_presence_count and is not a replacement for it. The widget's 100 exposed member rows are a subset, not the server member total. Voice counts describe public-widget-visible activity, not guaranteed complete private voice activity. Initial urllib probes were HTTP 403; curl succeeded. TypeSafe widget response had no widget collections.
